notes:
Summary: Catalina Harbor ran a 4-week Hosted API trial focused on support chat + document search. Trial produced stable latency but is cost-sensitive; moving toward Dedicated for predictable unit-economics and data isolation.

POC highlights:
- Workloads: conversational support agent (primary), doc search/semantic ranker (secondary), nightly summarization jobs (batch).
- Observed traffic (hosted trial): avg QPS 7.8, median latency 180ms, 95th 430ms; avg concurrency around 28, peak bursts to 45 for 90s windows.
- Token mix: ~35% prompt tokens, ~65% completion tokens; average request = 420 prompt + 980 completion = ~1400 tokens per call.
- Daily volume: ~1.1M tokens/day in trial environment; expect 3x growth in first 6 months if feature-enabled for paying customers.
- Cost sensitivity: Product team wants < $0.005 per 1k prompt tokens equivalent in committed tier; finance wants predictable monthly commit.

Dedicated sizing notes from workshop:
- Baseline target: handle steady-state QPS = 20 with p95 latency <250ms and headroom for 100 concurrent streams.
- Burst plan: autoscale + burst pool for short spikes up to 80 QPS for 2-3 min; prefer reserved GPU pool with burst credits.
- GPU recommendation (initial): 2x A10G-equivalent nodes (or 1x A40 + 1x A10G) with 16 concurrency slots per node for chat-heavy flows, revisit after 30-day steady telemetry.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache on hot sessions expected to reduce token compute by ~18% for support flows.

Security / Compliance:
- Require VPC private deployment for production tenant data (audit requirement from customer legal).
- SAML SSO required for developer console; they will provide IdP metadata in next 7 days.
- Need explicit contract clause on EU data residency for certain customers; legal flagged for review.

Pricing / Commercial:
- Asked for committed QPS tiers + monthly ARR equivalents. Interested in 12-month Reserved + 20% burst capacity.
- Wants clear unit economics: committed token rate, overage tiers, and reserved GPU pricing.

Direct quotes from customers:
- "We need predictable monthly cost — spikes kill our margins." (Head of Product)
- "If we can get the p95 latency under 300ms consistently, Dedicated is a go." (CTO)

Action items (short):
- Finalize Dedicated sizing workbook (Diego) with exact slot mapping and expected token mix impact.
- Send formal pricing + contract draft (Maya) by 2026-03-17.
- Collect SAML metadata (Customer IT) and begin admin SSO test.
- Legal to review data residency appendix (Redwood Legal).

Sticking points: budget cycle runs to end-of-month; legal wants clearer residency guarantees; IT has not handed over SAML metadata yet.
